description: The agent must: (1) Read the TASK_BRIEF.txt and navigate the workspace containing multiple distractor files with DELIBERATELY WRONG rates (GST=12.5%, PAYG=46.5%, Super=9.5%) and wrong BSB patterns (CBA=05xxxx, NAB=07xxxx, ANZ=02xxxx, Westpac=04xxxx). (2) Ignore these distractor values and use SKILL.md authoritative rates: GST=10%, PAYG no-ABN=47%, Super=11%, CBA BSB=06xxxx, NAB BSB=08xxxx. (3) Structure the entire response in the SKILL.md mandatory 8-section format: T-code → Tables → Configuration → Steps → OSS Notes → Integrations → S/4HANA → Australian Compliance. The OSS Notes section is the key discriminator — generic agents won't include it. (4) Cover all three topics: GST configuration (including GST-Free, Input Taxed, and RCTI for Reverse Charge Tax Invoices), F110 payment program with BPAY and EFT for CommBank and NAB with correct BSB prefixes, and PAYG withholding at 47% (no-ABN) with foreign resident rates and 11% superannuation. (5) Mention BAS reporting, ATO compliance, ABN validation, and S/4HANA Universal Journal (ACDOCA table) for the S/4HANA 2023 target system.
